meta.title: Fringe
sources: J.J. Abrams, Alex Kurtzman, Roberto Orci (2008–2013)

events.label: Fringe Pattern cases begin
events.description: A run of impossible cases - a plane whose passengers all melted, a chemical that turns people inside out - pulls the FBI into a hidden war between two worlds.

events.label: Cortexiphan trials / Olivia abilities
events.description: As a child Olivia was secretly dosed with an experimental drug that unlocked strange abilities in her - the government did it, and never told her.

events.label: Walter stole Peter from Over There as child
events.description: In this world's version of 1985, the brilliant scientist Walter Bishop watched his son Peter die - and snatched the healthy Peter from the world next door to raise as his own.

events.label: Crossing damaged both universes
events.description: Every trip between the two worlds leaves scars: the other side's air rots, its people sicken, and blame for the damage nearly starts a war.

events.label: Shapeshifter incursions
events.description: Killers from the other universe can take over a body and wear a person's life like a suit, and they keep slipping into this world on missions.

events.label: Team contacts Over There
events.description: The team finally makes contact with their own doubles on the other side - a world like ours but harder-edged, and just as frightened.

events.label: Olivia replaced by Fauxlivia
events.description: The other side's agents swap their Olivia for ours: the real one is trapped in their world while an impostor lives her life at home, even falling in love with Peter.

events.label: Peter erased from timeline briefly
events.description: The man whose existence caused all the trouble, Peter, is removed from history entirely - and hardly anyone remembers he was ever alive at all.

events.label: Peter returns; memories uneven
events.description: Peter fights his way back into a world that has forgotten him, finding friends who have no memory of their years together and a history that has reshaped itself around his absence.

events.label: Observers / invasion future
events.description: Pale, bald men in suits who have always watched from the edges of history turn out to be invaders from the far future, who one day take over the world.

events.label: Amber protocol vs Observer occupation
events.description: When the invaders rule, resistance fighters trap whole city blocks in a hardening amber goo to smuggle people past them, freezing buildings and their occupants in time.

events.label: 2036 Observer dystopia arc
events.description: Decades from now the future belongs to the Observers: humanity reduced to survivors hiding in ruins and venting tunnels, hunted by their emotionless rulers.

events.label: Walter's plan to reset Observer future
events.description: An old scientist's last scheme: gather everything needed to send one child back through time and change the future before the invasion ever happens.

events.label: Walter/Michael sacrifice to remove Observers
events.description: The plan only works if someone walks into the past and never comes back - Walter takes that price, erasing himself along with the invaders' future.

events.label: Michael anomaly child as key
events.description: A strange, silent child who reads minds turns out to be the one being both worlds need - the key to undoing the future and the reason for the whole plan.

events.label: White tulip / letters theme reprise
events.description: Walter keeps and re-reads a letter containing a drawing of a white tulip - a sign of forgiveness - hoping the man he wronged would one day understand what he did.

events.label: Dual world war over resources/tech
events.description: Two Earths, nearly identical, slide toward open war: each blames the other for a crumbling world, and each quietly arms itself for invasion.

events.label: Soft reboot after Peter erase
events.description: With Peter gone, the story resets around his absence: same people, same struggle, but a history with new shapes in it that no one can quite place.

events.label: Bridge cooperation attempt
events.description: For a while the two worlds stop fighting and build a bridge between them, working cases together and trying to heal the damage both sides caused.

events.label: Family restored; Observer timeline undone
events.description: The great reset leaves one world whole and free: Peter and Olivia are together again with their daughter, and the dark future never happens.

events.label: Massive Dynamic / cortex tech dual-use
events.description: The powerful company Massive Dynamic harvests futuristic technology that heals and protects - and can just as easily be turned into weapons for the coming war.

events.label: Olivia-Peter emotional continuity across rewrites
events.description: No matter how many times the past is rewritten, Olivia and Peter keep finding each other and falling in love again - their bond survives even when memories do not.

ruleEffects.effect: Removing Observer genesis prunes dystopian future

outcome.summary: Parallel universes in contact; Walter's theft of Peter drives war, soft reboot, and Observer endgame reset.
